title: GOVERNED AGENT INSTANTIATION / AGENT FACTORY CONVERGENCE
principle: AGENT IS A GOVERNED EXECUTION PARTICIPANT. AGENT IS NOT SYSTEM AUTHORITY.

authority_rules: RULE_1 AGENT IS A GOVERNED EXECUTION PARTICIPANT. AGENT IS NOT SYSTEM AUTHORITY.
RULE_2 AGENT != INTENT AUTHORITY.
RULE_3 AGENT != MISSION AUTHORITY.
RULE_4 AGENT != RRM AUTHORITY.
RULE_5 AGENT != RESOURCE-BINDING AUTHORITY.
RULE_6 AGENT != AUTHORIZATION AUTHORITY.
RULE_7 AGENT != CONFIRMATION AUTHORITY.
RULE_8 AGENT != VERIFICATION AUTHORITY.
RULE_9 AGENT != COMPLETION AUTHORITY.
RULE_10 AGENT != PRODUCT-RESPONSE AUTHORITY.
RULE_11 FACTORY_ONLY: CanonicalAgentFactory instantiates governed agents; creates zero default agents.
RULE_12 REGISTRY_ONLY: CanonicalAgentRegistry rejects duplicates, revokes fail-closed; presence is not authorization.
RULE_13 Factory must never invent a Mission; every GovernedAgent requires an explicit Mission binding.
RULE_14 Factory must never select resources, invoke providers, execute productively during creation, complete a Mission, fabricate verification, or mutate a product response.
RULE_15 Agent capability declarations are claims, never RRM availability or authorization.
RULE_16 Agent role names (admin/supervisor/manager/expert/master) grant no authority.
RULE_17 Autonomous Agent-to-Agent delegation is OUT OF SCOPE for M15.
RULE_18 No privilege amplification: an agent may not create another agent with broader scope.
RULE_19 Registry is not authorization; authorization remains with the existing gates.
RULE_20 M15 is additive: existing CanonicalAgentOrchestrator (3 legacy agents) and RRM registrations remain untouched.
obligations: OBLIGATION_1 CanonicalAgentFactory MUST generate identity via factory-assigned UUID, never user-supplied identity.
OBLIGATION_2 GovernedAgent lifecycle MUST transition through guarded states only.
OBLIGATION_3 GovernedAgent execution MUST route through the governed MissionRuntime path only.
OBLIGATION_4 GovernedAgent memory_scope MUST be a bounded reference; no memory access is granted at creation.
OBLIGATION_5 CanonicalAgentRegistry MUST reject duplicate identities without silent replacement.
OBLIGATION_6 CanonicalAgentRegistry MUST fail closed on revoked agents.
OBLIGATION_7 Factory/registry snapshot MUST be observable and free of secrets.
OBLIGATION_8 AgentSpec MUST reject unknown fields.
OBLIGATION_9 Agent role names MUST NOT be interpreted as authority.
OBLIGATION_10 M15 MUST preserve M11, M12, M13, M14 regressions.

OBLIGATION_11 M15 MUST remain the smallest canonical extension; no marketplace, negotiation, voting, self-modification, recursive delegation, automatic spawning, unbounded autonomous loops, or multi-provider orchestration beyond current authority.
OBLIGATION_12 M15 MUST NOT modify the Constitution.
